description: This PHP class 'Id' extends 'BaseOption' and defines validation logic for an 'id' parameter using Symfony's OptionsResolver and Validator components. It configures the resolver to require a string 'id' that matches either a numeric or UUID format.

classes.name: Id
classes.description: A class that adds validation rules for an 'id' parameter, ensuring it is a string matching either numeric or UUID format.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Sets up validation constraints for 'id' parameter: required, string type, and matches regex for numeric or UUID format.
